## Business pains
- PostHog views scaling its data pipeline as its primary challenge while distributing pipeline ownership to autonomous small teams. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEx1lJf9K6amjzcHYQx5C2ssyYLtvHwXk3GV3YVw8xOROImjji8IL58fzYzamXIG7Y-l1PlAhumSykZHSVtBBKsItw05fQXwYbS89tKBU1keuteWz5O8OLq) (quote: "The biggest challenge is scaling our data pipeline, and making sure we give as much responsibility as we can to each small team")
- PostHog finds scaling an engineering organization harder than scaling sales due to high coordination complexity and overlapping work. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEEtkIiqscGc0Q84FPf5KLh9oucQJN2-8CkQvxSpwzq1y5p2ejh_YSd95Att_WIs7X3Kh5z2KreVZce9C_R5PiWmtddq71hrqN_fxdR_hm_4pEULlixC_FKiXc=) (quote: "The disadvantage is that scaling an engineering team is, in our opinion, harder than scaling a sales team.")
- PostHog faces complexity maintaining consistency across multiple product comparison matrices against market alternatives. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEcyIIfVQ9MukFpJD8lDCNsefyxqVIErFJ0QiNHj8CRbZ3u-VD7ivvYHgpCb87Q5k6Dr1iUtoDByWfByneWmczttuA2ATe7gK_Uoab_BbVWqzOYaLScGfmmWrBGdOpsnvqtMyCQP_g0wC5KOS7M8oivyWl5tKdoxu1O3J1kvEg=) (quote: "Keeping product comparison charts up-to-date across a large website with multiple products is tricky, so we've built a way to source data")
- Hypothesis: Rapidly rising event volumes create continuous infrastructure cost pressure and data warehouse pipeline bottlenecks. (based on: The biggest challenge is scaling our data pipeline, and making sure we give as much responsibility as we can to each small team)
- Hypothesis: Scaling decentralized autonomous engineering teams risks duplicated code paths, architectural drift, and cross-team alignment hurdles. (based on: The disadvantage is that scaling an engineering team is, in our opinion, harder than scaling a sales team.)
- Hypothesis: Offering an all-in-one suite forces constant product maintenance to match specialized point-solution competitors across numerous distinct categories. (based on: Keeping product comparison charts up-to-date across a large website with multiple products is tricky, so we've built a way to source data)
